transcript: What? What? I know. Kay, you are massive. No, but- Tell me why I thought that I would only have to dress the bump in like warm months. You don't have any cold weather bump clothes? Nothing, but look! That fit at one point? I mean, yeah. I don't know if she can come out. She's so massive. What if she has my head? Maybe she won't. No, it's okay. You're gonna be able to push her out. I don't know how much more it can go. It used to be a cute accessory, and now it's my whole personality. Just wear baggy clothes. You don't understand. Baggy clothes look worse. Nuh-uh. I bought a baggy outfit thinking the same thing, Taylor. Do you wanna see it? Yes. What? What? I like it. I look like a ball of yarn. No, you don't. Like a teacher or something. I look like a librarian. No. She's just getting quite large. I wanna wear clothes again. What? I think she's gonna come out easy peasy, lemon squeezy. Mm-hmm. Want a snack or something? yeah what do you want? I want some more soup okay let me go make you some okay
metadata_caption: The baggy outfit was my favorite! 😂🤣 backstory ::: We are 36 weeks into this pregnancy journey, almost 37, and it’s been such an amazing experience. Yes there were struggles, yes there were pains, but overall it was amazing. We had so many laughs and so many fun new experiences. I have learned so much about pregnancy over the last few months, and that I can continue to learn so I can be a good father to our baby.  Kay wore the pregnancy beautifully, and was always in good spirits, even when she was hurting and struggling. She has done so good! ❤️ We are so excited to start this next journey as we enter the newborn phase! I believe that this adventure will be just as fun as pregnancy! I have so much to learn still, but I have Kay here as the expert on taking care of a baby. 😂 It won’t be much longer now! Next week, bean will be full term, and then we will just be waiting for her to decide to come meet us. ❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant
